title: ADA Analyte-Column Specification Registry
description: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification analyte-column definitions derived from technique TAPP spreadsheets. Each $def constrains one analyte-table reporting column (e.g. detectionLimit, xrayEmissionLine). TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs (schema.yaml#/$defs/<name>) so they resolve locally through the building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties of its own.

backgroundCorrectionMethod.title: Background Correction Method
backgroundCorrectionMethod.description: Method used to estimate and subtract background X-ray intensity beneath the peak. For WDS: typically 2-point off-peak linear interpolation or Mean Atomic Number (MAN) background model. For EDS: spectral background fitting or top-hat filter applied during spectral processing.

backgroundCountingPosition.title: Typical Background Position(s)
backgroundCountingPosition.description: Positions of background measurements relative to the peak, in mm and/or sinθ, and whether on the high or low energy side.

backgroundCountingTime.title: Background Counting Time
backgroundCountingTime.description: Total time spent counting at off-peak background position(s) in seconds, summed across all background positions.

blankCorrection.title: Blank Correction
blankCorrection.description: Method and reference material(s) used to determine and subtract blank signal contributions (e.g., carbon coat contribution to C signal, or background contamination for trace elements).

detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
detectionLimitMethod.description: Formula or approach used to calculate detection limits. Reference method publication if applicable. When the procedure does not specify a method, the analyst should complete this field.

edsDeadTime.title: EDS Dead Time
edsDeadTime.description: Percent dead time reported by the EDS spectrometer

elementEstimationMethod.title: Element Estimation Method
elementEstimationMethod.description: How elemental concentrations were calculated — directly from measured X-ray intensities or via cation stoichiometry.

empa_analyteEstimationMethod.title: Analyte Estimation Method
empa_analyteEstimationMethod.description: Whether elemental concentrations were calculated directly from measured X-ray intensities, or estimated by cation stoichiometry (e.g., oxygen calculated from cation proportions in silicates; carbon from stoichiometry in carbonates).

empa_analyticalAccuracy.title: Analytical Accuracy
empa_analyticalAccuracy.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary standards, expressed as percent relative bias. Include reference material, reference value source, and the measured value.

empa_analyticalPrecision.title: Analytical Precision
empa_analyticalPrecision.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements on the same or equivalent reference material, expressed as 1-sigma relative standard deviation (%). Include reference material name, number of analyses (n), and the measured value.

empa_backgroundPosition.title: Background Position(s)
empa_backgroundPosition.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

empa_beamCurrent.title: Beam Current
empa_beamCurrent.description: Probe current in nanoamperes (nA). Often varies by phase type or analyte; record the procedure-standard value(s).

empa_countingStatisticsError.title: Counting Statistics Error
empa_countingStatisticsError.description: Uncertainty predicted from counting statistics — the theoretical limit set by the Poisson distribution of the counts accumulated — for each reported quantity per analysis, with the sigma level stated. Derived from the counts on the analyte together with those on any background or blank subtracted from it. Distinct from the scatter actually observed within a measurement or between repeated measurements, which is recorded separately.

empa_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
empa_detectionLimit.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence (3-sigma), one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set), derived from counting statistics on peak and background. Include the method and the resulting value for each.

empa_diffractingCrystal.title: Diffracting Crystal
empa_diffractingCrystal.description: Analyzing crystal (monochromator) used on each spectrometer assignment. Crystal choice determines the detectable wavelength range and dispersion.

empa_epmaTechniquePerAnalyte.title: EPMA Technique per Analyte
empa_epmaTechniquePerAnalyte.description: Whether the measurement was made by WDS or EDS. Applies where a procedure uses both WDS and EDS.

empa_interferenceCorrectionsApplied.title: Interference Corrections Applied
empa_interferenceCorrectionsApplied.description: Whether a spectral interference correction was applied for each analyte. Common interferences include Ti Kb on V Ka, Cr Kb on Mn Ka, and Ba La on Ti Ka.

empa_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrecti.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
empa_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrecti.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied using secondary reference materials to correct for session-to-session calibration drift.

empa_primaryCalibrationStandardName.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
empa_primaryCalibrationStandardName.description: Name(s) of the primary reference material(s) used for element standardization (intensity calibration). Include the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used, since results calibrated against different published values for the same material are not directly comparable.

empa_proportionalCounterDetector.title: Proportional Counter / Detector
empa_proportionalCounterDetector.description: Type of detector used on each spectrometer assignment. Affects sensitivity and count rate linearity.

empa_secondaryReferenceMaterials.title: Secondary Reference Materials
empa_secondaryReferenceMaterials.description: Quality-control reference material(s) analyzed alongside unknowns to verify calibration accuracy. Include material name, assessed elements, number of analyses (n), and measured vs. accepted values.

empa_wdsPhaSetting.title: WDS PHA Setting
empa_wdsPhaSetting.description: Pulse height analyzer (PHA) setting for the WDS detector. Integral mode accepts all pulses above a threshold; Differential mode selects a narrow energy window to reject higher-order reflections and escape peaks.

empa_wdsSpectrometerChannel.title: WDS Spectrometer Channel
empa_wdsSpectrometerChannel.description: WDS spectrometer position(s) assigned to each analyte, one entry per assignment. An analyte may be assigned to more than one spectrometer with intensities aggregated (aggregate intensity counting), and one spectrometer serves several analytes across a run, so the assignment — not the analyte — is the unit carrying the spectrometer setup. Different spectrometers may have different crystal configurations.

empa_xRayBackgroundCorrectionMethod.title: X-ray Background Correction Method
empa_xRayBackgroundCorrectionMethod.description: Method used to estimate and subtract background X-ray intensity beneath the peak. For WDS: typically 2-point off-peak linear interpolation or Mean Atomic Number (MAN) background model. For EDS: spectral background fitting or top-hat filter applied during spectral processing.

empa_xRayLineOverlapCorrectionsApplied.title: X-ray Line Overlap Corrections Applied
empa_xRayLineOverlapCorrectionsApplied.description: Whether a spectral interference correction was applied. Common interferences include Ti Kb on V Ka, Cr Kb on Mn Ka, and Ba La on Ti Ka.

epmaTechnique.title: EPMA Technique per Element
epmaTechnique.description: Whether this element was measured by WDS or EDS.

interferenceCorrection.title: Interference Corrections Applied
interferenceCorrection.description: Flag indicating whether a spectral interference correction was applied for this element.

interferenceCorrectionStandard.title: Interference Correction Standard
interferenceCorrectionStandard.description: Reference material used to quantify and calibrate the interference correction.

interferingElements.title: Interfering Elements
interferingElements.description: Element(s) whose X-ray lines overlap with the measured peak, requiring a correction.

laMcicpmsUPb_analyticalAccuracyAndAssess.title: Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Method
laMcicpmsUPb_analyticalAccuracyAndAssess.description: Offset between measured and accepted values for secondary reference materials, and the method used to assess it. Specify the reference material and the source of its accepted values, the number of analyses, and the quantities assessed. Report systematic biases and their likely causes. Express the offset in the form appropriate to what the procedure reports - percent relative bias for concentrations, or deviation in delta or ratio units for isotopic quantities.

laMcicpmsUPb_betweenSessionAnalyticalPre.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
laMcicpmsUPb_betweenSessionAnalyticalPre.description: Precision of measurements across multiple analytical sessions over weeks to months — long-term or intermediate precision — and the method used to assess it. Report both the assessment method and the precision values, specifying the reference material, the number of measurements and sessions, the time span covered, and the statistic reported.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

laMcicpmsUPb_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
laMcicpmsUPb_detectionLimit.description: Session detection limit, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set), expressed in µg g⁻¹, ng g⁻¹, or wt% as appropriate. Mandatory at analysis level to demonstrate the reliability of reported near-detection-limit concentrations. The calculation method is captured separately in Detection Limit Method.

laMcicpmsUPb_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
laMcicpmsUPb_detectionLimitMethod.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate session detection limits. Mandatory at analysis level. Must be consistent with the method applied to generate the Detection Limit values reported above.

laMcicpmsUPb_interferenceCorrectionMetho.title: Interference Correction Method
laMcicpmsUPb_interferenceCorrectionMetho.description: Equation or procedure used to calculate and remove each interference contribution, together with how its magnitude was established - a monitor mass measured simultaneously and scaled by natural abundance ratios, a production-rate factor measured on a reference material or interference standard solution, or a tailing factor measured on a pure standard. Name the reference material used.

laMcicpmsUPb_interferingSpecies.title: Interfering Species
laMcicpmsUPb_interferingSpecies.description: The isobaric, polyatomic and doubly charged species that overlap the measured masses and are corrected in data reduction - direct isobars, oxides and argides, hydrides, and abundance-sensitivity tailing from an adjacent large beam. Name each species and the mass it affects.

laMcicpmsUPb_isobaricInterferenceCorrect.title: Isobaric Interference Corrections Applied
laMcicpmsUPb_isobaricInterferenceCorrect.description: Whether isobaric interference corrections were applied for any measured isotope in this procedure. A procedure-level Boolean: if the procedure includes interference corrections, this is always Yes. Detail for each affected mass is captured in Interfering Species and Interference Correction Method.

laMcicpmsUPb_limitOfQuantificationMethod.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
laMcicpmsUPb_limitOfQuantificationMethod.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the limit of quantification (LOQ): the lowest concentration reliably measurable with acceptable precision and accuracy. Required when concentrations near the LOD are reported.

laMcicpmsUPb_massResolutionAssignment.title: Mass Resolution Assignment
laMcicpmsUPb_massResolutionAssignment.description: Mass resolution mode used for acquisition. One analyte may be acquired at more than one resolution, so the assignment is per acquired mass rather than per element. The overall mode(s) used in the procedure are recorded in Mass Resolution Setting (Group 3).

laMcicpmsUPb_monitoredIsotopes.title: Monitored Isotopes
laMcicpmsUPb_monitoredIsotopes.description: Specific isotope(s) monitored in this procedure, grouped by the analyte element they serve where they serve one. Includes interference-monitor and internal-standard masses, which serve no analyte and so have no parent element. The analyte list is given by the Analyte field and is never inferred from the element symbols appearing here.

laMcicpmsUPb_monitoredMasses.title: Monitored Masses
laMcicpmsUPb_monitoredMasses.description: Specific masses monitored in this procedure, grouped by the analyte element they serve where they serve one. Covers atomic isotopes and, where a reaction cell shifts an analyte onto a different mass, the product mass actually measured. Includes interference-monitor and internal-standard masses, which serve no analyte and so have no parent element. The analyte list is given by the Analyte field and is never inferred from the element symbols appearing here.

laMcicpmsUPb_normalizationStandardsBased.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
laMcicpmsUPb_normalizationStandardsBased.description: Any post-acquisition normalization applied to correct for systematic biases identified from secondary reference materials, or stoichiometric normalization applied per pixel in mapping. Distinct from the primary internal standard approach captured in Internal Standard Approach.

laMcicpmsUPb_spectralInterferenceCorrect.title: Spectral Interference Corrections Applied
laMcicpmsUPb_spectralInterferenceCorrect.description: Whether mathematical corrections for isobaric, polyatomic or residual interferences are applied in data reduction, supplementary to any suppression already achieved by chemical separation, mass resolution, or a collision/reaction cell. Detail for each affected mass is carried by Interfering Species and Interference Correction Method.

laMcicpmsUPb_withinSessionAnalyticalPrec.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
laMcicpmsUPb_withinSessionAnalyticalPrec.description: Precision of repeated measurements within a single analytical session and the method used to assess it. Report both the assessment method and the precision values. The assessment method must specify the reference material or standard measured, the number of replicates n, and the statistic reported (1s RSD, 2s RSD, 2SD, 2SE, 95% CI). Distinct from the internal precision of a single measurement, which derives from counting statistics over the cycles of that measurement rather than from repeated analyses.

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

laMcicpms_analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmen.title: Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Method
laMcicpms_analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmen.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary reference materials, expressed as % relative bias. Report both the assessment method and the accuracy values. Specify: (1) secondary RM used and source of reference values, (2) number of analyses, and (3) elements or element groups assessed. Report any systematic biases and likely causes.

laMcicpms_betweenSessionAnalyticalPrecis.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
laMcicpms_betweenSessionAnalyticalPrecis.description: Reproducibility of measurements across multiple analytical sessions over weeks to months (long-term or intermediate precision). Report both the assessment method and the precision values. Specify: reference material used, number of sessions n, time span covered, and statistic reported. Long-term precision is typically assessed from a compiled record of secondary reference material values across all sessions.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

laMcicpms_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
laMcicpms_detectionLimit.description: Session detection limit, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set), expressed in µg g⁻¹, ng g⁻¹, or wt% as appropriate. Mandatory at analysis level to demonstrate the reliability of reported near-detection-limit concentrations. The calculation method is captured separately in Detection Limit Method.

laMcicpms_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
laMcicpms_detectionLimitMethod.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate session detection limits. Mandatory at analysis level. Must be consistent with the method applied to generate the Detection Limit values reported above.

laMcicpms_instrumentSensitivity.title: Instrument Sensitivity
laMcicpms_instrumentSensitivity.description: Instrument sensitivity achieved in the session, with the isotope or channel it was measured on and the conditions it applies to. May be expressed either as detected signal per unit concentration or per unit mass of analyte delivered — counts per second per ppb, volts per ppm, counts per picogram — or as useful yield, the percentage of sampled atoms ultimately detected as ions, with the method used to derive it cited. A sensitivity the procedure requires before analyses may begin belongs with the tuning acceptance criteria.

laMcicpms_interferenceCorrectionMethod.title: Interference Correction Method
laMcicpms_interferenceCorrectionMethod.description: Equation or procedure used to correct for isobaric interferences, including the production rate factor and the reference material used to measure it.

laMcicpms_interferingSpecies.title: Interfering Species
laMcicpms_interferingSpecies.description: Elemental or molecular species (oxides, argides, doubly charged ions) overlapping with the measured isotope.

laMcicpms_isobaricInterferenceCorrection.title: Isobaric Interference Corrections Applied
laMcicpms_isobaricInterferenceCorrection.description: Whether isobaric interference corrections were applied for any measured isotope in this procedure. A procedure-level Boolean: if the procedure includes interference corrections, this is always Yes. Detail for each affected mass is captured in Interfering Species and Interference Correction Method.

laMcicpms_limitOfQuantificationMethod.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
laMcicpms_limitOfQuantificationMethod.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the limit of quantification (LOQ): the lowest concentration reliably measurable with acceptable precision and accuracy. Required when concentrations near the LOD are reported.

laMcicpms_massResolutionAssignment.title: Mass Resolution Assignment
laMcicpms_massResolutionAssignment.description: Mass resolution mode used for acquisition. One analyte may be acquired at more than one resolution, so the assignment is per acquired mass rather than per element. The overall mode(s) used in the procedure are recorded in Mass Resolution Setting (Group 3).

laMcicpms_normalizationStandardsBasedCor.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
laMcicpms_normalizationStandardsBasedCor.description: Any post-acquisition normalization applied to correct for systematic biases identified from secondary reference materials, or stoichiometric normalization applied per pixel in mapping. Distinct from the primary internal standard approach captured in Internal Standard Approach.

laMcicpms_perAnalyteCalibrationStrategy.title: Per-Analyte Calibration Strategy
laMcicpms_perAnalyteCalibrationStrategy.description: Documents cases where different analytes or analyte groups within the same session are calibrated using different strategies — for example, one element used as the internal standard while trace elements are calibrated by an external reference material, or different primary standards applied to different mass ranges or mineral phases. If a single calibration strategy applies uniformly to all analytes, state that here and refer to Internal Standard Approach and Normalization / Standards-Based Correction for details. Free text; list the strategy for each analyte or analyte group as needed.

laMcicpms_sensitivityAsUsefulYield.title: Sensitivity as Useful Yield
laMcicpms_sensitivityAsUsefulYield.description: Instrument sensitivity expressed as useful yield: the percentage of sampled atoms of a given element ultimately detected as ions, with the method used to derive it cited. A more rigorous and more comparable statement of sensitivity than counts per second per unit concentration, which depends on spot size, fluence and repetition rate.

laMcicpms_withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisi.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
laMcicpms_withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisi.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements within a single analytical session. Report both the assessment method and the precision values. Assessment method must specify: (1) the reference material used, (2) number of replicates n, and (3) the statistic reported (1σ RSD, 2σ RSD, etc.). For mapping: assess from repeated analyses of a reference material area at session start and end, or from replicate analyses of a homogeneous reference phase within the map.

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

monochromatorCrystal.title: Diffracting Crystal
monochromatorCrystal.description: Analysing crystal (monochromator) used in the WDS spectrometer for this element.

normalization-standardsCorrection.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
normalization-standardsCorrection.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied using secondary reference materials.

peakCountingTime.title: Peak Counting Time
peakCountingTime.description: Time spent counting X-ray intensity at the peak position, in seconds, on each spectrometer assignment. Procedure specifies standard values; analysts may adjust within procedure-defined bounds.

primaryCalibrationStandard.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
primaryCalibrationStandard.description: Primary reference material used for element standardization (calibration).

pulseHeightAnalyzeSetting.title: WDS PHA Setting
pulseHeightAnalyzeSetting.description: Pulse height analyzer setting used for the WDS detector.

secondaryReferenceMaterial.title: Secondary Reference Materials
secondaryReferenceMaterial.description: List of quality-control reference materials (secondary standards) routinely analyzed alongside unknowns.

semComposition_analyteEstimationMethod.title: Analyte Estimation Method
semComposition_analyteEstimationMethod.description: Whether elemental concentrations were calculated directly from measured X-ray intensities, or estimated by cation stoichiometry (e.g., oxygen calculated from cation proportions in silicates; carbon from stoichiometry in carbonates).

semComposition_analyticalAccuracy.title: Analytical Accuracy
semComposition_analyticalAccuracy.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary standards, expressed as percent relative bias. Include reference material, reference value source, and the measured value.

semComposition_analyticalPrecision.title: Analytical Precision
semComposition_analyticalPrecision.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements on the same or equivalent reference material, expressed as 1-sigma relative standard deviation (%). Include reference material name, number of analyses (n), and the measured value.

semComposition_backgroundCorrectionMetho.title: Background Correction Method
semComposition_backgroundCorrectionMetho.description: Method used to estimate and subtract background X-ray intensity beneath the peak. For WDS: typically 2-point off-peak linear interpolation or Mean Atomic Number (MAN) background model. For EDS: spectral background fitting or top-hat filter applied during spectral processing.

semComposition_backgroundCountingTime.title: Background Counting Time
semComposition_backgroundCountingTime.description: Total time spent counting at off-peak background position(s) in seconds, summed across all background positions.

semComposition_backgroundPosition.title: Background Position(s)
semComposition_backgroundPosition.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

semComposition_beamCurrent.title: Beam Current
semComposition_beamCurrent.description: Electron beam probe current. For sub-nA values use decimal notation (e.g., 0.4 nA).

semComposition_blankCorrection.title: Blank Correction
semComposition_blankCorrection.description: Method and reference material(s) used to determine and subtract blank signal contributions (e.g., carbon coat contribution to C signal, or background contamination for trace elements).

semComposition_countingStatisticsError.title: Counting Statistics Error
semComposition_countingStatisticsError.description: Uncertainty predicted from counting statistics — the theoretical limit set by the Poisson distribution of the counts accumulated — for each reported quantity per analysis, with the sigma level stated. Derived from the counts on the analyte together with those on any background or blank subtracted from it. Distinct from the scatter actually observed within a measurement or between repeated measurements, which is recorded separately.

semComposition_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
semComposition_detectionLimit.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set). Include the method used and the resulting value for each.

semComposition_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
semComposition_detectionLimitMethod.description: Formula or approach used to calculate detection limits.

semComposition_diffractingCrystal.title: Diffracting Crystal
semComposition_diffractingCrystal.description: Analyzing crystal (monochromator) used on each spectrometer assignment. Crystal choice determines the detectable wavelength range and dispersion.

semComposition_interferenceCorrectionSta.title: Interference Correction Standard
semComposition_interferenceCorrectionSta.description: Reference material used to quantify and calibrate the interference correction.

semComposition_interferenceCorrectionsAp.title: Interference Corrections Applied
semComposition_interferenceCorrectionsAp.description: Whether a spectral interference correction was applied for each analyte. Common interferences include Ti Kb on V Ka, Cr Kb on Mn Ka, and Ba La on Ti Ka.

semComposition_interferingElements.title: Interfering Elements
semComposition_interferingElements.description: Element(s) whose X-ray lines overlap with the measured peak, requiring a correction.

semComposition_normalizationStandardsBas.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
semComposition_normalizationStandardsBas.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied using secondary reference materials to correct for session-to-session calibration drift.

semComposition_peakCountingTime.title: Peak Counting Time
semComposition_peakCountingTime.description: Time spent counting X-ray intensity at the peak position, in seconds, on each spectrometer assignment. Procedure specifies standard values; analysts may adjust within procedure-defined bounds.

semComposition_primaryCalibrationStandar.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
semComposition_primaryCalibrationStandar.description: Name(s) of the primary reference material(s) used for intensity calibration in EDS or WDS quantification. Include the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used, since results calibrated against different published values for the same material are not directly comparable.

semComposition_proportionalCounterDetect.title: Proportional Counter / Detector
semComposition_proportionalCounterDetect.description: Type of detector used on each spectrometer assignment. Affects sensitivity and count rate linearity.

semComposition_secondaryReferenceMateria.title: Secondary Reference Materials
semComposition_secondaryReferenceMateria.description: Quality-control reference material(s) analyzed alongside unknowns to verify calibration accuracy. Include material name, assessed elements, number of analyses (n), and measured vs. accepted values where available.

semComposition_techniquePerAnalyte.title: Technique per Analyte
semComposition_techniquePerAnalyte.description: Records which X-ray detection technique (EDS or WDS) was used to collect the measurement. Required when a procedure employs both EDS and WDS simultaneously. List in the same order as the Analyte field.

semComposition_timeDependentIntensityCor.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
semComposition_timeDependentIntensityCor.description: Type of time-dependent intensity (TDI) correction applied to compensate for beam-induced volatilisation or migration of sensitive elements (e.g., Na, K, F in glasses, feldspars, carbonates).

semComposition_wdsPhaSetting.title: WDS PHA Setting
semComposition_wdsPhaSetting.description: Pulse height analyzer (PHA) setting for the WDS detector. Integral mode accepts all pulses above a threshold; Differential mode selects a narrow energy window to reject higher-order reflections and escape peaks.

semComposition_wdsSpectrometerChannel.title: WDS Spectrometer Channel

solutionQicpms_isobaricInterferenceCorre.description: Whether mathematical corrections for isobaric or polyatomic interferences are applied during data reduction (in addition to any KED or DRC mitigation in the instrument).

solutionQicpms_limitOfQuantificationMeth.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
solutionQicpms_limitOfQuantificationMeth.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the limit of quantification (LOQ): the lowest concentration reliably measurable with acceptable precision and accuracy. Required when concentrations near the LOD are reported.

solutionQicpms_monitoredIsotopes.title: Monitored Isotopes
solutionQicpms_monitoredIsotopes.description: Specific isotope(s) monitored per analyte element in this protocol, including any interference-monitor masses. Analyte-specific field.

solutionQicpms_withinSessionAnalyticalPr.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
solutionQicpms_withinSessionAnalyticalPr.description: Precision of repeated measurements within a single analytical session and the method used to assess it. Report both the assessment method and the precision values. The assessment method must specify the reference material or standard measured, the number of replicates n, and the statistic reported (1s RSD, 2s RSD, 2SD, 2SE, 95% CI). Distinct from the internal precision of a single measurement, which derives from counting statistics over the cycles of that measurement rather than from repeated analyses.

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

solutionSficpms_analyticalAccuracyAndAss.title: Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Method
solutionSficpms_analyticalAccuracyAndAss.description: Offset between measured and accepted values for secondary reference materials, and the method used to assess it. Specify the reference material and the source of its accepted values, the number of analyses, and the quantities assessed. Report systematic biases and their likely causes. Express the offset in the form appropriate to what the procedure reports - percent relative bias for concentrations, or deviation in delta or ratio units for isotopic quantities.

solutionSficpms_betweenSessionAnalytical.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
solutionSficpms_betweenSessionAnalytical.description: Precision of measurements across multiple analytical sessions over weeks to months — long-term or intermediate precision — and the method used to assess it. Report both the assessment method and the precision values, specifying the reference material, the number of measurements and sessions, the time span covered, and the statistic reported.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

solutionSficpms_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
solutionSficpms_detectionLimit.description: Elemental detection limits, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set). Specify units (µg/g or µg/L) and whether values are procedure-typical estimates or session-specific measured values.

solutionSficpms_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
solutionSficpms_detectionLimitMethod.description: Method used to calculate detection limits for each reported concentration variable.

solutionSficpms_dwellTimePerMass.title: Dwell Time per Mass
solutionSficpms_dwellTimePerMass.description: Count (dwell) time at the mass position, in milliseconds. Where the procedure defines it per sweep or per scan rather than per measurement, state that basis.

solutionSficpms_interferenceCorrectionMe.title: Interference Correction Method
solutionSficpms_interferenceCorrectionMe.description: Equation or procedure used to calculate and remove each interference contribution, together with how its magnitude was established - a monitor mass measured simultaneously and scaled by natural abundance ratios, a production-rate factor measured on a reference material or interference standard solution, or a tailing factor measured on a pure standard. Name the reference material used.

solutionSficpms_interferingSpecies.title: Interfering Species
solutionSficpms_interferingSpecies.description: The isobaric, polyatomic and doubly charged species that overlap the measured masses and are corrected in data reduction - direct isobars, oxides and argides, hydrides, and abundance-sensitivity tailing from an adjacent large beam. Name each species and the mass it affects.

solutionSficpms_isobaricInterferenceCorr.title: Isobaric Interference Corrections Applied
solutionSficpms_isobaricInterferenceCorr.description: Whether mathematical corrections for residual isobaric or polyatomic interferences are applied in data reduction (supplementary to any interference suppression achieved through mass resolution selection).

solutionSficpms_limitOfQuantificationMet.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
solutionSficpms_limitOfQuantificationMet.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the limit of quantification (LOQ): the lowest concentration reliably measurable with acceptable precision and accuracy. Required when concentrations near the LOD are reported.

solutionSficpms_massResolutionAssignment.title: Mass Resolution Assignment
solutionSficpms_massResolutionAssignment.description: Mass resolution mode used for acquisition. One analyte may be acquired at more than one resolution, so the assignment is per acquired mass rather than per element. The overall mode(s) used in the procedure are recorded in Mass Resolution Setting (Group 3).

solutionSficpms_massResolutionPerAnalyte.title: Mass Resolution per Analyte
solutionSficpms_massResolutionPerAnalyte.description: Mass resolution mode assigned to each analyte in this procedure. The selected resolution determines which polyatomic interferences are physically resolved by the magnet sector. Per-analyte assignments are documented here; the overall mode(s) used in the procedure are recorded in Mass Resolution Setting (Group 3). Analyte-specific field.

solutionSficpms_monitoredIsotopes.title: Monitored Isotopes
solutionSficpms_monitoredIsotopes.description: Specific isotope(s) monitored in this procedure, grouped by the analyte element they serve where they serve one. Includes interference-monitor and internal-standard masses, which serve no analyte and so have no parent element. The analyte list is given by the Analyte field and is never inferred from the element symbols appearing here.

solutionSficpms_monitoredMasses.title: Monitored Masses
solutionSficpms_monitoredMasses.description: Specific masses monitored in this procedure, grouped by the analyte element they serve where they serve one. Covers atomic isotopes and, where a reaction cell shifts an analyte onto a different mass, the product mass actually measured. Includes interference-monitor and internal-standard masses, which serve no analyte and so have no parent element. The analyte list is given by the Analyte field and is never inferred from the element symbols appearing here.

solutionSficpms_spectralInterferenceCorr.title: Spectral Interference Corrections Applied
solutionSficpms_spectralInterferenceCorr.description: Whether mathematical corrections for isobaric, polyatomic or residual interferences are applied in data reduction, supplementary to any suppression already achieved by chemical separation, mass resolution, or a collision/reaction cell. Detail for each affected mass is carried by Interfering Species and Interference Correction Method.

solutionSficpms_withinSessionAnalyticalP.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
solutionSficpms_withinSessionAnalyticalP.description: Precision of repeated measurements within a single analytical session and the method used to assess it. Report both the assessment method and the precision values. The assessment method must specify the reference material or standard measured, the number of replicates n, and the statistic reported (1s RSD, 2s RSD, 2SD, 2SE, 95% CI). Distinct from the internal precision of a single measurement, which derives from counting statistics over the cycles of that measurement rather than from repeated analyses.

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

spectrometerNumber.title: WDS Spectrometer Channel
spectrometerNumber.description: WDS spectrometer number used for this element.

timeDependentIntensityCorrection.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
timeDependentIntensityCorrection.description: Type of time-dependent intensity (TDI) correction applied to compensate for beam-induced volatilization or migration of sensitive elements (e.g., Na, K, F in glasses, feldspars, carbonates).

typicalAnalyticalAccuracy.title: Typical Analytical Accuracy
typicalAnalyticalAccuracy.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary standards, expressed as % relative bias.

typicalAnalyticalPrecision.title: Typical Analytical Precision
typicalAnalyticalPrecision.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements on the same or equivalent standard, expressed as 1σ relative standard deviation (%).

typicalCountingStatisticsError.title: Typical Counting Statistics Error
typicalCountingStatisticsError.description: 1σ uncertainty propagated from counting statistics on peak and background intensities.

typicalDetectionLimit.title: Typical Detection Limit
typicalDetectionLimit.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence (3σ) for each measured element.

wdsDetectorType.title: Proportional Counter / Detector
wdsDetectorType.description: Type of detector used in the WDS spectrometer for this element.

xrayEmissionLine.title: X-ray Line
xrayEmissionLine.description: The X-ray emission line measured for this element.
